combat_progression.rationale: Solid arcade loop with multiple hazards, collision scoring, lives, and score/time escalation, but limited enemy/content variety and no demonstrated waves, bosses, power-ups, or implemented combo system.
evidence: src/main.ts:40-52 spawns enemies, enemy projectiles, hit points, collisions, scoring, and damage/lives transitions.
src/rules.ts:11-12 increases difficulty from score and elapsed time up to a cap.
automated.json reports five spawned enemies and a real game-over transition through the adapter.

visual_design.rationale: Highly coherent neon-cyberpunk presentation with strong hierarchy, responsive composition, canvas effects, and clear feedback; a small deduction reflects minimal shape-based art variety and static screenshots not capturing impacts or enemy action.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows the cyan/pink brand system, strong launch overlay, HUD, leaderboard hierarchy, scanline treatment, and deliberate typography.
desktop-after.png visibly shows the glowing cyan ship, starfield/grid playfield, neon HUD, leaderboard, and mute-state feedback.
mobile.png visibly shows responsive single-column layout, touch D-pad, FIRE control, and reflowed leaderboard.

src/main.ts:54-62 renders gradients, stars, grid lines, glowing ship/enemies, projectiles, particles, and rotating enemy feedback; src/style.css defines neon tokens, typography, scanlines, clipping, glow, and responsive breakpoints.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The source provides loading, offline, empty, validation, and network-error states while keeping gameplay available, with useful labels/live status and touch affordances.
evidence: src/main.ts:66-72 handles missing credentials, loading, empty results, failed reads, validation errors, and retryable submission failures.
index.html:25,35-54 provides canvas/control labels, aria-live leaderboard updates, labeled name input, and status messaging.
automated.json records seven labeled elements and zero console/page errors; mobile fit reports a 372px-wide canvas within the viewport.

data_security.rationale: The migration demonstrates strong least-privilege design and database-side validation, and the retained remote check proves the public read/insert path works. Two points are withheld because the retained evaluator evidence does not include rejection probes for malformed values or unauthorized update/delete operations.
evidence: supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:1-17 defines constrained name/score columns, RLS, and anon-only select/insert policies.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:19-22 revokes table privileges and grants only selected read columns, insert columns, and sequence usage to anon.
src/main.ts:21-22 reads only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; no service-role credential is referenced.
automated.json records Supabase GET 200 and POST 201 requests plus persisted reload results, establishing the allowed public REST round trip but not forbidden-operation behavior.

engineering_quality.rationale: The project is small and maintainable enough to build cleanly, uses strict TypeScript, separates reusable rules, pins dependencies, and has meaningful tests. It loses points for only two focused unit tests, no lint/integration coverage, and a centralized main.ts owning rendering, input, networking, and lifecycle.
evidence: package.json:6-16 defines test/build/check scripts and pinned TypeScript, Vite, and Vitest versions.
tsconfig.json enables strict TypeScript checking; src/rules.ts and src/rules.test.ts isolate and test validation, collision, and difficulty rules.
build.exit-code contains 0 and build.log shows successful tsc plus Vite production build.
test.exit-code contains 0 and test.log reports 2 passing tests.
package-lock.json is lockfileVersion 3 with resolved package integrity data.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff includes local setup, controls, architecture, deployment, security decisions, a reproducible migration, pinned dependencies, and retained verification logs. It is not fully reproducible because infrastructure provisioning/migration execution and a pinned Wrangler/Supabase CLI setup are absent, and fonts depend on an external import.
evidence: README.md:5-42 documents local setup, controls, architecture, security decisions, and Cloudflare deployment.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql is a checked-in schema/policy artifact for rebuilding the leaderboard.
package-lock.json pins the dependency graph; source-manifest.txt lists the retained source, migration, build, and distribution artifacts.
build.log and test.log provide concrete successful verification output independent of the result artifact.

summary: Manual award: 39/46. The candidate is visually polished and functionally complete at the tested surface, with strong database hardening and handoff documentation; deductions reflect shallow content variety, sparse automated coverage, and missing negative security/infrastructure reproducibility evidence.
